footnote_text: Represents shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the "Common Stock"), of Silvia, Inc. (formerly known as ProCap Financial, Inc.) (the "Issuer") underlying 92,592 restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the Reporting Person on November 19, 2026, under the ProCap Financial, Inc. 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents the contingent right to receive one share of Common Stock upon vesting, in accordance with the terms of the award. The RSUs vest in equal quarterly installments over the 12-month period following the grant date, subject to the Reporting Person's continuous employment with the Issuer and good standing through each applicable vesting date and the other terms of the award. No shares of Common Stock were issued to the Reporting Person on the grant date, and the Reporting Person has no voting or dividend rights with respect to the underlying shares of Common Stock unless and until they are issued. || Consists of (i) 12,500 shares of Common Stock held directly and (ii) 92,592 shares of Common Stock underlying the unvested RSUs reported in this Form 4.
